back: Queries data in S3 from Redshift without loading it, using external tables from the Glue Data Catalog.

es.back: Consulta datos en S3 desde Redshift sin cargarlos, usando tablas externas del Glue Data Catalog.

back: Glue: serverless ETL + Data Catalog + crawlers. EMR: managed (or Serverless) Spark/Hadoop clusters for custom big data.

es.back: Glue: ETL serverless + Data Catalog + crawlers. EMR: clústeres administrados (o Serverless) de Spark/Hadoop para big data a medida.

back: MSK: managed Apache Kafka (keeps the Kafka APIs). Kinesis: AWS-native service with its own API.

es.back: MSK: Apache Kafka administrado (mantiene APIs de Kafka). Kinesis: servicio nativo de AWS con su propia API.

back: Not encrypted by default (use VPN over DX or MACsec). Resilience: connections at different locations or a backup VPN.

es.back: No cifra por defecto (usa VPN sobre DX o MACsec). Resiliencia: conexiones en ubicaciones distintas o VPN de respaldo.

back: A regional hub that connects thousands of VPCs, VPNs, and Direct Connect; supports inter-Region peering and route tables for segmentation.

es.back: Hub regional que conecta miles de VPC, VPN y Direct Connect; soporta peering entre regiones y tablas de rutas para segmentar.

back: DataSync (online, NFS/SMB/HDFS/S3), Data Transfer Terminal (offline, bring your own devices; Snowball Edge is closed to new customers), Transfer Family (SFTP/FTPS to S3/EFS), Storage Gateway (continuous hybrid).

es.back: DataSync (en línea, NFS/SMB/HDFS/S3), Data Transfer Terminal (fuera de línea, llevas tus dispositivos; Snowball Edge ya no acepta clientes nuevos), Transfer Family (SFTP/FTPS a S3/EFS), Storage Gateway (híbrido continuo).

back: Centralized backups for many services with plans, cross-Region/cross-account copies, Organizations policies, and Vault Lock (WORM).

es.back: Respaldos centralizados de muchos servicios con planes, copias entre regiones/cuentas, políticas de Organizations y Vault Lock (WORM).

back: CloudWatch: metrics, logs, alarms, and dashboards. CloudTrail: API call auditing. Config: resource configuration state and compliance.

es.back: CloudWatch: métricas, logs, alarmas y dashboards. CloudTrail: auditoría de llamadas a la API. Config: estado y cumplimiento de configuración de recursos.

back: A trail created from the management account that logs all accounts; member accounts cannot modify it.

es.back: Trail creado desde la cuenta de administración que registra todas las cuentas; las cuentas miembro no pueden modificarlo.

back: Spot up to 90%, EC2 Instance Savings Plans / Standard RIs up to ~72%, Compute Savings Plans up to ~66%, Convertible RIs ~66% (flexible).

es.front: Modelos de compra de cómputo y descuentos
es.back: Spot hasta 90%, EC2 Instance Savings Plans / RI estándar hasta ~72%, Compute Savings Plans hasta ~66%, RI convertibles ~66% (flexibles).

back: Cost Explorer, Budgets, CUR/Data Exports, Compute Optimizer, Trusted Advisor, Cost Optimization Hub, Cost Anomaly Detection, S3 Storage Lens.

es.back: Cost Explorer, Budgets, CUR/Data Exports, Compute Optimizer, Trusted Advisor, Cost Optimization Hub, Cost Anomaly Detection, S3 Storage Lens.

back: Inbound from the internet, within the same AZ over private IPs, and from S3/AWS origins to CloudFront. Charged: outbound to the internet, between AZs, and between Regions.

es.front: Transferencia de datos: qué es gratis
es.back: Entrada desde Internet, dentro de la misma AZ con IP privada y de S3/origen AWS a CloudFront. Se cobra: salida a Internet, entre AZ y entre regiones.

back: Gateway endpoints for S3/DynamoDB (free) remove the NAT data processing charge for that traffic.

es.back: Gateway endpoints para S3/DynamoDB (gratis) eliminan el cargo de procesamiento del NAT para ese tráfico.

front: S3 classes by cost and access
back: Standard > Intelligent-Tiering (automatic) > Standard-IA > One Zone-IA > Glacier Instant (ms) > Glacier Flexible (min–h) > Deep Archive (12–48 h, cheapest).

es.front: Clases de S3 por costo y acceso
es.back: Standard > Intelligent-Tiering (auto) > Standard-IA > One Zone-IA > Glacier Instant (ms) > Glacier Flexible (min–h) > Deep Archive (12–48 h, la más barata).

back: IA and One Zone-IA: 30 days and 128 KB minimum billable. Glacier Instant/Flexible: 90 days. Deep Archive: 180 days.

es.back: IA y One Zone-IA: 30 días y 128 KB mínimos facturables. Glacier Instant/Flexible: 90 días. Deep Archive: 180 días.

back: Standard: up to 1 year, exactly-once, auditable. Express: high volume and short duration (up to 5 min), cheaper per execution.

es.back: Standard: hasta 1 año, exactly-once, auditable. Express: alto volumen y corta duración (hasta 5 min), más barato por ejecución.

back: Serverless event bus: pattern rules, SaaS sources, Scheduler, archive/replay, Pipes, and schema registry.

es.back: Bus de eventos serverless: reglas por patrón, fuentes SaaS, Scheduler, archive/replay, Pipes y schema registry.

back: Enable ReportBatchItemFailures to retry only the failed messages in the batch; configure a DLQ on the queue.

es.back: Habilita ReportBatchItemFailures para reintentar sólo los mensajes fallidos del lote; configura DLQ en la cola.

back: Scheduled automatic rotation with Lambda functions (native for RDS, Aurora, Redshift, DocumentDB).

es.back: Rotación automática programada con funciones Lambda (nativa para RDS, Aurora, Redshift, DocumentDB).

back: Very high-performance local NVMe disk at no extra cost, but ephemeral: lost when the instance is stopped or terminated.

es.back: Disco NVMe local de muy alto rendimiento y sin costo extra, pero efímero: se pierde al detener o terminar la instancia.
